This '''unidentified red [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droid]]''' worked on [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell's]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
This [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droid]] was made into an action figure by [[Hasbro]] and came with the exclusive [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]] figure made for the ''Vintage Collection'' line.
